messages:
maggie: heads up  after the RBAC cleanup this morning, SCIM started dropping some members from 'gov-admins'. Not consistent, seems tied to longer attributes (emails/display names).

sam: can you paste logs?

maggie: sure, snippet: 
```
2025-06-01T09:12:34Z ERROR scim/provisioner: PATCH /Groups/0xA... returned 400 - attribute 'members' truncated
assertion_size=12345 bytes, payload_hash=sha256:ab12...
```
jordan: that smells like SAML attribute truncation. anyone touch the Okta mapping or group expansion? any KMS signing errors?

maggie: idp-bot reported an AssertionTooLarge around 09:12:33. Platform KMS logs show successful decrypts for signing key, no decrypt errors.

izaac: audit logs show role assignment events with missing group attrs, which would cause orphaned roles.

sam: short-term workaround: switch to sending group IDs (shorter) instead of full verbose names. long-term: move memberships to SCIM or compress claims.

maggie: testing group-id mapping in staging now. command used: 
```
scim-patch --env=staging --file=patch-groups.json
```
jordan: create a vuln ticket to assess if truncation could cause privilege changes.

maggie: opened SEC-2025-143; assigned @sam for audit triage and @izaac to handle mapping change with Okta.

idp-bot: probe: SAML assertion size=12512 bytes > configured_max=12288 - rejected by IdP.

sam: confirmed Okta enforces ~12KB for SAML attributes. options: shrink SAML payload or rely on SCIM.

izaac: KMS angle: decrypts are fine but double-check JWE/envelope headers and cert chain used for signing; a rotated cert could change encoding/size.

maggie: we rotated the SAML cert last night ~02:00. rolled back to previous cert and retriggered staging SCIM resync; staging resync restored members.

sam: runbook we followed: 
```
1) pause scim sync: POST /api/admin/scim/pause
2) rollback cert: POST /api/admin/saml/rotate-cert?action=rollback&from=prev
3) trigger scim resync: POST /api/admin/scim/resync?group=gov-admins
4) verify audit: GET /api/admin/audit?entity=group&from=09:00
```
jordan: agreed next steps: 1) change Okta mapping to externalId/group-id, 2) add SCIM-only fallback for groups exceeding threshold, 3) update incident runbook with cert-rotation checklist and KMS header verification, 4) schedule coordinated cert rotation with Okta and notify customers.

maggie: I'll draft the postmortem and link SEC-2025-143: https://docs.internal/reports/SEC-2025-143  adding timeline and mitigations.

sam: :thumbsup:

maggie: thanks, closing after postmortem review.
